historical_context: The Stone Chariot is located in the Vittala Temple complex in Hampi, a UNESCO World Heritage site. It was built during the Vijayanagara Empire period (circa 16th century) under the reign of King Krishnadevaraya.
verified_facts: The Stone Chariot in Hampi is a famous monolithic shrine dedicated to Garuda.
The design of the current 50 Rupee note of the Mahatma Gandhi New Series features the Hampi Stone Chariot on the reverse side.
Hampi is located in the Bellary district of Karnataka, India.
reasoning: The combination of the specific architectural features of the Hampi chariot (wheels, elephant figures) and its direct appearance on the held currency note confirms the identity of the site with absolute certainty.
additional_observations: The image exhibits a high dynamic range due to the sun being positioned directly behind the monument, causing significant silhouettes.
The stone carving style is distinctly Vijayanagara Dravidian architecture.
